dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the astute and the absurd...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: As you see, ours is a cafe and not a tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: There are some gentlemen here who will speak of all manner of things while resting — and I find myself wishing that they said them with the excuse of being drunk.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: I fear that what people say when sober might be even more absurd than the babblings of drunkards.
